title: Grammar: Advanced Learner Mistakes
speaker: BBC Learning English
description: Dan explains the most common grammar mistakes made by advanced English learners — misuse of articles, prepositions, and complex tenses — and how to fix them.

title: Grammar: Present to Talk About the Past

speaker: BBC Learning English

title: Grammar: Mixing Conditionals
speaker: BBC Learning English
description: Dan teaches mixed conditionals — combining different conditional forms to talk about unreal situations with complex time relationships between past and present.

speaker: BBC Learning English

speaker: BBC Learning English

title: Grammar: Using 'What' to Give Emphasis
speaker: BBC Learning English

title: Inversion 1: After Negative or Limiting Adverbs
speaker: BBC Learning English

speaker: BBC Learning English
description: Dan covers reduced conditionals ('Had I known...', 'Were I to...') and other advanced inversions — formal structures found in literary, academic, and professional English.

title: How to Choose the Correct Tense in English

description: Dan explains the difference between gerunds and infinitives after verbs like 'stop', 'remember', 'try', and 'regret' — verbs that change meaning depending on which form follows.
